hero.introduction: A passionate Software Engineer with experience in building scalable web and mobile applications, and automating solutions. I specialize in full-stack development using modern technologies and enjoy solving complex problems.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I am a Software Engineer with expertise in full-stack development, leveraging technologies like Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Supabase, Flutter, Dart, Firebase, and Python. I specialize in building robust web and mobile applications, and I’m passionate about creating efficient, scalable solutions.
about.paragraph2: With a strong background in software development and a degree in Computer Science, I continuously expand my technical skills. I enjoy tackling complex problems and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful results using modern development practices and tools like Git, Docker, and various cloud services.

responsibilities: Accelerated feature delivery by building reusable **React.js** component systems and enforcing shared conventions with **Laravel**, reducing integration friction across the frontend and backend teams.
Eliminated device-compatibility defects across phone, tablet, and desktop by implementing a systematic mobile-first responsive design process with **TailwindCSS**.
Improved perceived page-load speed on high-traffic views by introducing code splitting and lazy loading, managed via **Redux** and **React Query** for efficient state and data synchronization.

Shipped a trading-bot web app MVP on an accelerated timeline by leading frontend architecture with **React.js**, **Next.js**, and **TypeScript** — translating Figma specs into strict, modular components with near-zero drift from design intent.
Enabled real-time trading workflows by integrating RESTful APIs via **React Query** with environment-based configuration, supporting live bot execution and monitoring.

Expanded the platform to mobile by engineering a cross-platform **Flutter** app with biometric authentication (Face ID / Touch ID) and full RTL/LTR support, making the product accessible to Arabic-speaking users.
Delivered 5+ client projects on time by building responsive, mobile-first UIs with **React.js**, **Redux**, and **Tailwind CSS**, translating client briefs directly into production-ready interfaces.
Maintained robust offline functionality for field users by developing and deploying **Flutter** mobile apps with **Firebase**, geolocation, and local storage caching.
Owned full-stack delivery across projects — from database schema design in **PostgreSQL** to API development with **Django** and UI delivery with **Next.js** and **Supabase**.
Achieved on-time delivery across all engagements by surfacing blockers early, clarifying requirements upfront, and aligning on acceptance criteria before development.

Replaced a manual, paper-based extension program workflow by building a full-stack admin system with **Next.js**, **PostgreSQL**, **Prisma**, and **TailwindCSS** — covering the entire data lifecycle from submission to reporting.
Reduced document handling overhead for administrators by delivering 10+ responsive UI modules with integrated file management via **Amazon S3** and secure role-based access through **NextAuth.js**.
Ensured consistent, reproducible environments from development to production by containerizing the application with **Docker**, eliminating environment-specific deployment failures.
Contributed to a faster job-search experience by building core UI components for an AI-powered job search assistant in **React.js**, prioritizing responsiveness across device sizes.
Reduced repetitive QA cycles by creating a reusable **Storybook** component library, enabling isolated visual testing and consistent UI across the product.
Increased user engagement potential by developing a data-driven sleep monitoring widget in **React**, personalizing the dashboard with health metrics drawn from user-owned data.
Developed a CRUD application for school management using Java and MySQL, streamlining administrative processes.
Implemented visitor rating features for offices and faculty members, enhancing user interaction and feedback collection.
Created an admin dashboard with data visualization, providing insights and improving decision-making.
